title: lessingia glandulifera var. tomentosa
intro: Lessingia glandulifera var. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Lessingia, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is native to the coastal regions of California in the United States. The health benefits of Woolly Lessingia include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
